data.name: Kreedha
data.gender_notes: Kreedha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kreedha is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'kreeda', meaning 'the game', 'the play'. It symbolizes the spirit of playfulness, creativity, and adventure. It is also associated with the Hindu God Krishna, who is known for his mischievous and playful nature. The name Kreedha carries the meaning “The Game, The Play” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Kreedha usually hope their child will grow to embody the game, the play and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kreedha is a name that embodies the playful and creative energy of the divine. It reminds us to find joy and delight in the present moment, and to approach life with a sense of wonder and curiosity.
data.etymology: Kreedha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Game, The Play.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kreedha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kreedha can represent the divine play or leela of the Universe, where everything is interconnected and unfolds in a meaningful way.
